Sofia, the records I can see point to Kwame Adjei-Rowe for Pellucid Harbor Logistics. Bettina's public cutover note (Dec 2025) says the account moved to Kwame on Nov 22, 2025, and her message in #coastal-team this week says Pellucid stays with Kwame. I couldn't find an account profile or any later ownership change, so if support has a newer record, that would override this.

Before you send the ticket on, check its org ID. The Coastal cheat sheet warns that "PHL" is also the shorthand for Covey & Lark Retail, now Pellow Home Living, which Bettina is covering. If the ticket's org is Pellow, it belongs with Bettina, not Kwame.
